findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

Numerous ants were observed on the floor by the sink next to the entrance to the bakery preparation area. The PIC was shown and prepared a work order for the issue. While that was taking place the employee currently in the area indicated that a work order had already been placed. The PIC was able to find the order in the system and show the inspector during the inspection. The order was placed on 10/10. No action was observed in their system since then in relation to this situation. The inspector will follow-up in 10 days for compliance or progress.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

The corner molding at the mop sink in the produce room next to the bakery area was observed with the covering damaged and missing. The PIC was shown and instructed to repair prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all surfaces around sinks are smooth and easily cleanable to protect against mold growth.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. 

The hand sink in the produce walk in was blocked by crates on inspector arrival in the area. The PIC was consulted and removed the obstructions to correct the violation. Ensure that all hand sinks are maintained easily accessible at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 

1) Several locations throughout the facility have minor cleaning needing to be conducted. Sweeping is needed under shelves in the walk in coolers, on shelves on the retail floor and under/behind shelves in the walk in freezers. Moping also needs to take place in the walk in cooler in the bakery. Multiple locations were shown to the PIC conducting the walk through and they are instructed to ensure that regular cleaning is taking place to reduce/remove cleaning issues. Maintain the floors clean at all times. 2) Ceiling grates in the meat room and bakery back room are observed with large amounts of dust accumulation. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean often enough to prevent accumulation at these locations.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
2-102.11: Based on the RISKS inherent to the FOOD operation, PIC shall demonstrate knowledge by:  (A) Having no Priority Foundation items; (B) Being a CFM; OR (C) Responding correctly questions as they relate to the specific FOOD operation. The areas of knowledge include C1 through C16.  

The dish machine noted in line item #16 is in need of maintenance. Repair prior to the follow up being scheduled in two weeks.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-702.11: UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning. 

The hot water sanitizing in the bakery dish machine would not register above 150F on the inspector’s maximum registering thermometer. The color changing dots at the facility and the inspector’s thermolabels were unable to produce color changes either. This indicates that the hot water sanitizing is not reaching the critical temperature of 160F. The daily check for this machine for today and yesterday are also not available. As a temporary measure the three part sink will be used to sanitize dishes from the bakery. Refer to line item #1 for the follow up for the dish machine.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. [P]

Foods in multiple open faced coolers are observed with international temperatures of 45F to 50F. This appears to be exclusively a stocking issue and not a cooler issue as the items noted appear to be sticking out beyond the shelves (packages of sliced meats, chopped lettuce, etc.) or packed high without allowing adequate airflow to be maintained cold (sausage). Stocking practices were discussed with the PIC. Items that are observed out of temperature were discarded during this inspection to correct. Review stocking practices with employees.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. 

There is a gap between the three part sink in the bakery and the wall behind it. Plumbing feeds directly through the sink meaning that it cannot be easily pulled away from the wall for cleaning. It does appear that the sink used to be sealed to the wall and the sealing was removed. Reseal to the wall so that there is a smooth and easily cleanable surface. It was suggested that quarter round or some other filler may make the process simpler.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment: Observed 15+ dented cans between the soup and fruit aisles. CORRECTED- Discussed with PIC. Cans were removed from sale shelves. Educate stockers on what to look for in terms of package integrity while stocking.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. [Pf]

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Foods in bunker coolers (hot dogs, cheese) and open wall coolers (raw salmon, yogurt, shredded cheese) observed 43 to 50F. CORRECTED— Discussed stocking practices to allow sufficient air flow to keep foods cold. PIC educated employees and adjusted/rearranged products or pulled items to walk-in coolers to cool to 41F or below. Review best practices with stocking employees.
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. [P]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
No soap present at the bakery handwashing sink. CORRECTED-- Soap provided.
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: Observed bakery handsink soiled with icing. Ensure handwashing sinks are only used for handwashing. CORRECTED- Discussed with PIC. Icing was wiped out of the sink.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (Pf)

findings.comment: Observed 8+ dented cans in the soup and fruit aisles. CORRECTED- Discussed with PIC. Cans were removed from sale shelves. Educate stockers on what to look for in terms of package integrity while stocking.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. (Pf)

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Observed wall-mounted quaternary ammonium dispenser to be dispensing at between 0 and 100ppm. PIC called equipment provider. CORRECTED- Discussed sanitizer use in the meantime: Check sanitizer package for manufacturer instructions for manual preparation, use test strips to confirm proper, safe concentration is achieved if mixing sanitizer by hand.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114 (C) (2) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. (P)

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment: Observed two dough scrapers stored between the knife rack and the wall. Ensure all utensils are stored in clean locations and are protected from contamination. CORRECTED- Utensils were removed and will be cleaned and sanitized. Find a storage location that prevents contamination of utensils.
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11  (A) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of FOOD- and lip-contact surfaces is prevented. (C)

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed single service items in the back to be pulled off the shelf, out of their container, and laying on a plastic tote used for storage that is in the open with no cover. Ensure that single service items are stored in a manner that prevents potentials for cross contamination. 
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed a pooling of water on the floor behind the oven in the service area. Behind this pooling of water it was noted that there was an accumulation of mold on the coving. It appears as though this has been an on going issue. Ensure that measures are taken to avoid this accumulation of pooling water and that the coving is cleaned. Ensure floors are maintained in good repair, as well as in a clean state. 
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.citation_text:
750.160 & 510 - Employee was observed handling boxes and touching general surfaces with gloved hands and did not change gloves prior to returning to task of bagging bread. Employee was advised on changing gloves between tasks and handwashing between glove changes. Employee was then observed waiting on a customer and did not wash hands between glove changes. Training employees on proper handwashing and glove use were discussed with management.
 
Gloves shall be single use and used for only 1 task. Gloves shall be discarded when damaged, soiled or after an interruption in operations.
Employees shall properly wash their hands any time they may have become contaminated, before putting on gloves/between glove changes and prior to handling food, clean equipment, and unwrapped single service articles.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text:
750.1100 - Condensate drain line from bakery walkin cooler was not positioned over the floor drain under the 3 part sink. Puddling water was observed in the corner below the 3 part sink. No apparent evidence was observed to indicate a leak was present at the condensate pipe where it comes out of the wall. Get the drain line repaired so it is positioned over the floor drain to allow for proper draining of condensate from the walkin cooler.  

Drain lines from equipment shall not discharge waste water in such a manner as will permit the flooding of floors or the flowing of water across working or walking areas or into difficult-to-clean areas, or otherwise create a nuisance.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.
Observed the carts that hold trays of bread for baking, are soiled along the sides and wheels with some baked on grease. Clean the units.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.
Observed a box of hand wipes stored on the floor in the bakery area. 
Store single service items 6" off the floor to protect them from contamination.
CORRECTED = Box was put on pallet.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.citation_text: 750.130 - Tupperware containers of flour and sugars were not labeled. Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name. Label containers with the common name of bulk food items.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.citation_text: 750.860 - Drawer with clean utensils was soiled with debris. Store clean and sanitized utensils and other equipment at least 6 inches off the floor in clean, dry locations in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means. Keep storage drawers clean to protect utensils from potential contamination.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.citation_text: 750.1120 - Front handsink in bakery department was blocked by metal racks. Handsinks are to be accessible at all times to allow for proper handwashing. Metal racks were moved. Do not block handsinks for any reason.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment: 750.130f - Spray bottle with clear liquid on a prep table did not have a label on it. Bottle contained water. Label all bottles as to contents. Unless its identity is unmistakable bulk foods (i.e. cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar, flour, etc.) not stored in original container or package and spray bottles shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - Baked goods cooling on the top of roll cart were not protected from potential overhead contamination. Place a clean baking sheet or another appropriate item above food items cooling on the top of roll carts. Foods shall be protected at all times.
